stories.title: Ombudsman finds BCUHB failings after patient given morphine in error and died two days later
stories.summary: The Public Services Ombudsman for Wales has issued a public interest report finding that Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board issued a patient with morphine sulphate in error on discharge from Wrexham Maelor Hospital, and that he died of a morphine overdose two days later. stories.title: North and West Wales faces 42% radiologist shortfall as new census reveals Wales worst for patient harm
stories.summary: Wales is the only part of the UK where every radiology department leader has seen patients’ conditions worsen because of staff shortages, according to the Royal College of Radiologists’ annual workforce census.
